description: Update fields in one section of the organization's active Operating Plan. Provide the section_key and ONLY the fields to change; fields you do not name are preserved (merge, never replace). Common fields: foundation = purpose, mission, values (the core values, one per line), ideal_customer; destination = year_target, ten_year_target, revenue_goal, profit_goal, defining_metric; annual_game_plan = primary_objective, strategic_initiatives, key_outcomes. List-like fields are newline-separated strings.

fields.description: Field key -> new value, only the fields to change. List-like fields take one entry per line.

name: update_operating_plan_section
